content_policy: Hashes, coordinates, counts and render parameters only; game bytes, localized text and preview PNGs remain outside this committed manifest.

runtime.promotion_rule: Only a matching first-intermission screenshot and exact original-to-localized texture delta may promote both the scene mapping and localized atlas.
